irac.issue: Whether a suit for specific performance can be filed against a proposed transferee who has not yet completed the transfer in their favour.
irac.rule: A proposed transferee who has entered into an agreement to purchase a property is bound by the terms of the agreement and can be proceeded against for specific performance.
irac.application: The appellate court erred in dismissing the suit for specific performance against the proposed transferee (Ram Kumar) who had entered into an agreement to purchase the property.
irac.conclusion: The appeal is allowed and the suit for specific performance can proceed against Ram Kumar.
